systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation; direction de l'identification civile; delivered by the national police authority of the applicant's place of residence
systems.tiers: Produced only by the centres of Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire; delivered by the national police at the place of residence

note: Describes the identity card under Décret 2007-207 of 2 April 2007: issued from age 16 on an original civil-status document (birth declaration, birth act, late declaration, family booklet, transcribed jugement supplétif or acte de notoriété), and a civil-status officer drawing up a death act must collect the card for the direction de l'identification civile. An identity system; nothing on how civil registration offices make their records.
